Comment: Connect Migration State Machine v6.4 - Read only target verification (VerifyTarget) before the secret cleanup

IndependentResourcesMigrationFlow.Comment: Phase 1: Independent resources including Lambda/Lex associations

DecideQueueMigration.Comment: Queue migration runs BEFORE user migration to provide queueMapping/hoursMapping

DecideUserMigration.Comment: User migration runs AFTER queue migration to have access to queueMapping/hoursMapping

VerifyTarget.Comment: Read only checks of the target after every migration phase; needs the ExternalId secret, so it runs before CleanupExternalIdSecret. The report reads the full result from the history

VerifyTargetFailed.Comment: The verify step itself failed: overwrite the caught error with a verdict, still clean up and report, and end Failed

ContactFlowsPhase.Comment: Phase 2: Contact Flows (after Lambda/Lex are associated)

DecideQuickConnectsMigration.Comment: Quick Connects run AFTER users to have access to user mapping

CleanupExternalIdSecret.Comment: Delete the per execution ExternalId secret on success and on failure, before the report so the report includes the result

QueuesPhaseError.Comment: Queues failed; the report marks the step FAILED and the next phase still runs

UsersPhaseError.Comment: Users failed; the report marks the step FAILED and the next phase still runs

BuildMigrationReport.Comment: Summarise every step and the secret cleanup; FAILED if any step, item or the cleanup failed

FinalMigrationStatus.Comment: Succeed only if the report succeeded (it fails on a FAIL or ERROR verification) and no ExternalId secret is left behind; otherwise end Failed with the most specific reason

TargetVerificationErrored.Cause: The VerifyTarget step could not run, so the target was not verified. Its error code is in the verification section of the migration report.

TargetVerificationFailed.Cause: The VerifyTarget step found problems in the target. See the verification section and the failed steps of the migration report.

MigrationFailed.Cause: One or more steps or items failed, or the ExternalId secret cleanup failed. See the migration report.

EnsureHoursResult.Comment: Seed $.createHoursResult from $.defaults if an earlier phase was skipped or failed

EnsureQueuesResult.Comment: Seed $.createQueuesResult from $.defaults if an earlier phase was skipped or failed

EnsurePhase1Result.Comment: Seed $.phase1Results from $.defaults if an earlier phase was skipped or failed
